##### Project general facts

Body Sense is an innovative wellness resort powered by biohacking technologies, offering a full-cycle experience built on complete rejuvenation and full-body restoration, on prime pink-zone land with a long-term leasehold structure. This next-generation complex features designer spa units, relaxation zones, and ocean-view terraces. The resort is designed for guests seeking deep recovery through evidence-based biohacking, combining luxury hospitality with transformative wellness programs.

Body Sense offers an extensive spa and bath culture complex with public and individual sections. The thermal zone includes a hammam, salt room, sauna, Roman bath, snow room, and pool. The hydro zone features massage suites, a hydromassage bathtub, and a jacuzzi. A functional gym and yoga space support physical wellness, while a restaurant serves a calorie and macro-balanced menu. Each room extends the spa experience with ritual-by-room amenities, including infrared saunas or lamps, copper baths, tea ceremony sets, skincare fridges, and yoga accessories.

Every suite at Body Sense is thoughtfully designed to support deep recovery and sensory restoration. Deluxe spa suites feature king-size orthopedic beds with infrared saunas, copper baths, and private balconies with ocean views. Premium spa suites include infrared lamps, yoga accessories, tea ceremony sets, and skincare fridges. Natural materials, calming aesthetics, and premium finishes create a serene environment where every element contributes to physical and spiritual balance.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in one of Bali’s most prestigious coastal areas, this exceptional location places residents just minutes from world-famous beaches, including Pandawa, Melasti, and Nusa Dua. The area is renowned for its white sands, dramatic limestone cliffs, turquoise lagoons, and vibrant beach club scene. Guests can enjoy legendary clubs, fine dining, and cultural landmarks such as GWK Park, all within a short radius.

The location is distinguished by its strategic convenience and wealth of leisure activities. Ngurah Rai International Airport is easily accessible via a modern toll road, while golf courses, a helipad, and paragliding are nearby. The area’s high concentration of premium beaches and attractions ensures strong year-round demand from wellness-focused travelers.

For those seeking a residence that embodies oceanfront luxury, holistic wellness, and strong investment potential, this location delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, advanced infrastructure, and growing global recognition as a wellness destination makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can restore, rejuvenate, and reconnect, serene, sophisticated and perfectly positioned.
